title: Practice 1: Genitive endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Эта рубашка из ___ (стопроцентный) хлопка.
exercises.prompt: This shirt is 100% cotton.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Никто не любит ___ (непрошеный) советов.
exercises.prompt: Nobody likes unsolicited advice.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Из ___ (дравидийский) языков наиболее распространены телугу, тамильский, каннада и малаялам.
exercises.prompt: Of the Dravidian languages, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam have the most speakers.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: С ___ (однобокий) точки зрения взрослого дети часто проявляют непослушание.
exercises.prompt: From an adult's one-sided point of view, children's attitudes often seem to be disobedient.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Для ___ (всеобщий) увеселения я сегодня буду в мини-юбке.
exercises.prompt: For general amusement, I'm wearing a mini-skirt today.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Он жил здесь с ___ (пятилетний) возраста.
exercises.prompt: He has lived here since he was five years old.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Здесь так много ___ (синтаксический) ошибок...
exercises.prompt: There are so many syntax errors...
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Мирей Матьё — одна из ___ (хороший) певиц Франции.
exercises.prompt: Mireille Mathieu is one of France's best singers.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Я пришёл из ___ (земной) недр.
exercises.prompt: I came from the depths of the earth.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Если кому-то не завидуют, значит, у него нет ___ (завидный) качеств.
exercises.prompt: If someone is not envied, they don't have enviable qualities.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Том умер от ___ (пищевой) отравления.
exercises.prompt: Tom died from food poisoning.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: У меня много ___ (неженатый) друзей и подруг.
exercises.prompt: I have many unmarried friends.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: У меня закончился наполнитель для ___ (кошачий) туалета.
exercises.prompt: I ran out of cat litter.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Мы сдружились с ___ (сам) начала.
exercises.prompt: We hit it off right off the bat.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Хабаровск - один из ___ (крупный) городов Дальнего Востока России.
exercises.prompt: Khabarovsk is among the largest cities of the Russian Far East.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Я переняла у Тома несколько ___ (плохой) привычек.
exercises.prompt: I learned several bad habits from Tom.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Английский посол потребовал ___ (непосредственный) встречи с президентом.
exercises.prompt: The English ambassador demanded to meet with the President directly.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Автострада была перекрыта из-за ___ (серьёзный) аварии.
exercises.prompt: The motorway was closed because of a major accident.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Нет ___ (установленный) расписания, которому вы должны следовать.
exercises.prompt: There's no set schedule that you need to follow.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Том съехал из ___ (родительский) дома.
exercises.prompt: Tom moved out of his parents' house.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.
